k10k2arm.baseName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant White Tinsel
k10k2arm.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant White Tinsel
k10k2arm.sourceDescription: Create a bright and striking Christmas display with our 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant White Tinsel. Combining a full 8-ply construction with an impressive 12cm thickness, it provides substantially more volume and coverage than standard tinsel, making it particularly effective for larger Christmas trees and festive displays. The crisp white finish combines fine and wider reflective strands to create a full, textured appearance that catches the surrounding light beautifully. Against traditional green Christmas foliage, the white tinsel creates a particularly striking contrast and can also be used to complement snowy, winter-themed and contemporary Christmas displays. Supplied in a generous continuous 50m length, you can use the tinsel as one long run or simply cut it into the individual lengths required for your display. This makes it particularly useful for larger decorating projects and allows multiple areas to be decorated without having to join together lots of shorter retail-sized lengths. The tinsel is also fire retardant, making it a practical choice for commercial festive displays as well as decorating around the home. Whether you're wrapping a large Christmas tree, decorating railings and displays or creating a substantial commercial installation, this extra thick white tinsel provides plenty of length and coverage for creating a bold, beautifully finished Christmas display. Product Features • 50m extra thick white tinsel • Full 8-ply construction • Generous 12cm thickness • Bright white reflective finish • Full, dense appearance • Supplied in one continuous 50m length • Easily cut to your required lengths • Fire retardant • Ideal for large Christmas trees and displays • Perfect for domestic and commercial decorating Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
